utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard the basics, but I’m ready to help if there’s anything still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure of the full list either, but I know we still need the repair drive details cleared up. Once Hana shares them, I’ll help sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds fine by me. I’m ready to help once Hana clears up the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll see what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Jules mentioned the repair drive is coming up soon, and I can help connect folks if you want me to.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a big help, Opal. If you can connect folks, I’ll work out what I can take on and fit it into the plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I can bring the toolbox by and take a look if that drive starts acting up again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, if it starts acting up again, I can help you unload the supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah. If the drive acts up again, I’ll bring the toolbox by and we’ll sort it out together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can bring those over, Vik. Just tell me where you want me to set them down.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Set them by the garage door for now and I’ll sort through them there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll set them by the garage door and leave the rest to you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll bring the supply list and we can sort out the repair drive details together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s the weekend repair drive, right? Just confirming what needs fixing before I bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, the weekend repair drive. I’m bringing the supply list so we can go through what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now, so if you can come by or send a hand, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Quinn. I’ve got an eye out too, and I can swing by if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Ira. I’ll keep spreading the word, and I may take you up on that help if we get buried in the work.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I can help load and unload the repair supplies.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, Leo, but please be careful not to block the walkway when you unload.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I’ll keep it clear of the walkway.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon, and I can help connect folks if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing on the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly small home fixes, like loose hinges, broken shelves, and other little repairs people bring by. I can help you word it more clearly if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Rey. I’ve got the repair drive list in hand, and I’ll help keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll head over to the old fence by the mailbox and see how things are starting.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Rey. I’ll keep the list moving on my side while you check the fence, and we can compare notes once you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s really picking up this afternoon. Folks have been bringing by tools and a bit of cash all morning.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I can bring over a few supplies later today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a huge help, Uli. Bring whatever you can later, and I’ll make sure it gets where it’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just the basics to start: checking what’s broken and then fixing it step by step.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, but what parts are we checking first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the small stuff: loose hinges, leaky faucets, and a few broken outlets.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I can handle those. Send me the details for the hinges, faucets, and outlets.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Kira, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now, so if you can come by or lend a hand, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive this weekend, right? What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, this weekend. Mostly small stuff like loose hinges, squeaky doors, and anything else folks spot that I can pass along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up steam, so I’m keeping an eye out for anyone who needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Let’s talk through what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’m glad to hear it. Let me know what still needs fixing, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Gus. Let’s start with the basics and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli. I’ll keep it simple and check the old fence by the mailbox first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good idea, Rey. Check that fence first, and I’ll take the next spot after you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing on the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can cover the pickup runs, and I’ll help with the drive too. Just send me the details on what needs to be moved.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, I’ll send over the details so we keep the move straight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard the basics, but folks are starting to organize tasks. I can fill you in on what I know if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, fill me in. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits, but I can check the back fence and let you know if it needs anything else.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon, and I’m happy to help connect folks if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can help with that, but I’ll need the list of what’s actually broken first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, send me the broken-item list and I’ll help round up the right people.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think I can help with that. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we need to keep track of the tools and cash so nothing gets misplaced.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that makes sense. I can help keep track of the tools and cash.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon, and I can help connect folks if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. I can use help connecting folks and loading supplies.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, I can do that. Send me the details and I’ll help get folks connected and supplies loaded.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can try to stop by for a bit. Thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks. Even a short stop-by helps, and we can point you to the easy fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s picking up again this afternoon. Folks have been dropping off tools and a bit of cash all morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly little fixes and upkeep: broken fence boards, a leaky sink or two, and some wobbly chair legs. Folks are bringing whatever they can help with.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to ask you about that earlier, but my mind slipped - what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll bring the supply list, and if you can handle any tools or tape, that’d help us get the repair drive set up cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can handle the tools and tape. I’ll bring them by when I come over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara. I’ve got a toolbox if you need it, and I can swing by to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s kind of you, Gus. I can use the toolbox, and I’ll let you know what still needs doing so we can sort the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara. I’ll bring the toolbox by, and once you’ve pointed out what’s left, we’ll get the repair drive sorted.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
